content: FastAPI readiness pattern: never conflate liveness/readiness. Liveness = bare endpoint, no I/O, no response_model (validation failure would 422 and probes treat non-2xx as unhealthy), include_in_schema=False. Readiness: registry of dependency checks each with asyncio timeout (~2s), run in parallel via asyncio.gather, return 200 only when all critical pass else 503 with per-check breakdown; check real function not boolean flag (file freshness = stat mtime, don't mutate state in probes, to_thread for blocking fs). Use lifespan (not deprecated on_event). asyncio.Event for ready state. Keep health routes out of auth middleware (LB probes need unauthenticated reach); 503 also during graceful shutdown drain.
